excerpt.zh: 我们对[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系的扫描显示，它的小行星带是一种非同寻常的类型。与通常组成这类结构的岩石、冰块加太空垃圾的大杂烩不同，它看起来像是许多大型的人造居住站所形成的残骸。这显然是在过去几千年内的某个时间被难以想象的暴力所摧毁的。这片残骸场中必然潜藏着许多不为人知的秘密，但由于体量巨大，进行测绘就需要花费挺长的时间。

texts.zh: 我们对[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系的扫描显示，它的小行星带是一种非同寻常的类型。与通常组成这类结构的岩石、冰块加太空垃圾的大杂烩不同，它看起来像是许多大型的人造居住站所形成的残骸。这显然是在过去几千年内的某个时间被难以想象的暴力所摧毁的。这片残骸场中必然潜藏着许多不为人知的秘密，但由于体量巨大，进行测绘就需要花费挺长的时间。
texts.en: Our scans of the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system show that its asteroid belt is of an unusual variety. Instead of the standard mix of rocks, ice and space rubble that usually make up such formations, it seems to be the remains of a number of large, artificial habitats. These must have been destroyed with incredible violence sometime in the last few millennia. Untold secrets may be contained within the resulting debris field, but it is so extensive that charting it out could take quite some time.

texts.zh: 我们并不是第一个在[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系发现该碎片环带的：我们发现了一架小到被我们[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]戏称为“太空小屋”的飞船，里面有一具毒物类外星人的遗骸和无数的数据水晶。根据腐坏的程度推断，这名外星人最有可能是在短短几个世纪前去世的。
texts.en: We are not the first to discover the debris belt in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system: a craft - so small that our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] are dubbing it a "space cabin" - has been found, containing the remains of a single toxoid alien and a considerable number of data crystals. Judging by the rate of decay, our best guess is that this alien expired only a few centuries ago.

texts.zh:
在外星人的太空小屋里发现的数据水晶实际上是一些任务日志。我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]已经发回了一个样本及其简单翻译。它开头的的语调振奋人心：

“这是一生中绝无仅有的好机会。传说中奥德瑞斯基亚水触手可及。我的新家有点差强人意，但对我已经很满足了，因为我很快就可以寄回家足够的钱付给女儿治病了。”

然而很快，日志就变得酸楚了起来：

“妻子和女儿都死了。世上不再有人会悼念我。在黑市上贩卖打捞所得仅仅足以维持生活。现在后悔已经太晚了。”

这名外星人总共在碎片环带白费了五十多年的时间搜罗宝物但一无所获。
texts.en:
The data crystals discovered in the alien's space cabin are in fact mission logs. Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have sent us a sample, along with a preliminary translation. They start in an upbeat tone:

"This is the chance of a lifetime. The ruins of the fabled Odryskans are within reach. My new home isn't much, but it's good enough for me, and soon I'll be able to send enough credits home to pay for my daughter's treatment."

Soon enough however, the logs grow sour:

"Wife and daughter dead. No one left to mourn for me. Salvage sold on black market barely enough to support living costs. Too late to turn back now."

All told, the alien spent over five decades trawling the rubble belt in an apparently futile search for riches.

label.zh: 他们在这么长的时间里肯定能发现些什么！
label.en: Surely they found something in all those years!

texts.zh:
不可能
不可能
不可能
不可能
骗子！
……
……
……
万一是真的呢？

随着这名外星人滑入疯狂的深渊，日志的内容也变得越来越令人毛骨悚人。
texts.en:
It is not true
It is not true
It is not true
It is not true
LIES!
...
...
...
But what if it is true?

The logs become increasingly disturbing as the alien slips further and further into madness.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]完成了对外星人日志水晶的翻译。他们呈递了最后一份日志的翻译，这份日志是在该外星人死前不久记录下的，记录者罕见地意识清醒：

“我终于找到了我一直苦苦追寻的东西。很多人会觉得我花这么多年找来找去跟疯了一样。我觉得，可能这些人也没错。我已经快老死了，我的亲朋好友也早都入土了。不管找到了什么宝贝，现在把它卖了也毫无意义，但我应该可以安息了。”

日志后面附上了这位外星人找到宝藏的位置。依据这份日志，我们追踪到了一块体积令人震惊的巨型宝石，它的价值无法估量。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have finished translating the alien's data crystals. They present an interpretation of the last log, in which, not long before their death, the recorder experiences a rare moment of lucidity:

"I have finally found what I am looking for. Many would consider me mad for continuing the search this long. I think, probably, that they are right. I am old, now - dying, even - and my kin are long since dust. There is no point in selling the artifact, but perhaps now I can find peace."

The logs go on to pinpoint where the alien concealed the treasure. By following them, we have tracked down an astonishingly large gemstone of immeasurable value.
